turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until twenty to five, so let's not waste it. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me.
I didn't come for thanks. Why did that zero go into the gradebook before anyone picked up a phone?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
Small talk. Okay. I'm still waiting on why my son saw a zero before I heard a word from you.
What do you do for fun?
This is how you want to spend my eighteen minutes? Talk about Owen, or I'll take it to the principal's office.
